steps.title: How it works
steps.subtitle: Three steps, three clicks — the same simple flow for every tool.
steps.s1desc: Pick files from your device, or simply drop them in.
steps.s2desc: Set your options with a live preview before running.
steps.s3desc: Save, share, or chain straight into the next tool.

categories.title: Explore the toolbox
categories.subtitle: {count} tools across {categories} categories — with an honest mode badge on every tool.
categories.phaseNote: Roadmap order: device-only tools first, server tools last.

why.title: Why DocoPDF?
why.subtitle: Honest, private, and built mobile-first for India.
why.privateDesc: Device-only tools never send your files anywhere. What's yours stays yours.
why.fastDesc: No upload wait — processing happens on your own device, even offline.
why.freeDesc: No signup, no watermarks, no hidden limits on device tools. Ever.

modes.title: Two honest modes
modes.subtitle: Every tool tells you exactly where your file goes — nothing hidden.
modes.deviceDesc: The whole job runs in your browser using Web Workers. Your file never touches the network.
modes.devicePoint1: Merge, split, compress, sign, edit and much more
modes.devicePoint2: Works offline once installed as an app
modes.devicePoint3: Zero upload time — great for batches
modes.serverDesc: Only for jobs a browser can't do well (like Office ↔ PDF). Files are deleted immediately after processing — never stored.
modes.serverPoint1: Deleted right after the job (15-minute fail-safe)
modes.serverPoint2: No file names or contents in any log
modes.serverPoint3: Clear limits: 10 free server tasks per day

tools.title: All tools
tools.subtitle: {count} tools across the toolbox — favorites and recent tools stay on this device.
tools.noResultsDesc: Try a different word, or tell us what you need — we build the most-requested tools first.
tools.searchHint: Search as you type — try “merge”, “jodein” or “password”.

request.title: Request a tool
request.description: Tell us what's missing. Requests are saved on this device until tool-request voting goes live.
request.descPlaceholder: A short description of what you need…

palette.title: Search tools
palette.description: Search the DocoPDF toolbox by name, tag or Hindi keyword.

consent.title: Your choice, your data
consent.body: DocoPDF works without analytics. Allow anonymous usage counts to help us improve? No file names, no file contents — ever.
consent.analyticsDesc: Aggregate tool usage counts only. Always off for file contents.
consent.essentialNote: Essential cookies (language, theme, favorites) are always on and stay on your device.

pro.title: Pro is coming
pro.body: Paid features arrive in a later phase. Device-only tools will always stay free — that's a promise.

footer.trust: Most tools run inside your browser. Your files stay on your device.
footer.phaseNote: DocoPDF is being built in phases — the design system is live, tools are next.
